en.name: Ocean perch
en.summary: Ocean perch is a deep-water rockfish, sold almost always as skin-on fillets with the bright orange-red skin left in place — that skin is how the species is identified on the slab. The flesh is firm and mildly sweet and carries a little more oil than a flatfish, which is what puts its freezer window at 4–8 months rather than longer. From purchase it keeps 1–2 days in the fridge.
en.pantry: None. Two things work against a fillet of ocean perch before it ever reaches your kitchen. It is caught in deep water a long way out, so much of what sits on the counter was frozen at sea and thawed for display, which means its clock started well before you saw it — ask, because if the answer is previously frozen you must not refreeze it raw. Carry it home in a cool bag and observe the 2-hour limit, or 1 hour once the day is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Fish keeps best just above freezing, colder than a fridge runs, so set the fillets on a rack inside a lidded box with ice beneath and a route for the melt water to drain away from the fish. Leave the skin on while it sits: it is edible, it crisps beautifully, and until it meets the pan it is a barrier between the flesh and the air. Pull the pin bones before you store it rather than after, so the fillet is handled once instead of twice. Fresh ocean perch smells of clean seawater; the moment it smells of ammonia it is finished, and deep-water fish reach that point quickly.
en.freezer: 4–8 months at −18 °C (0 °F). The oil that gives ocean perch its flavour is also what limits the window, so wrap for the long end rather than the short: film pressed against the fillet with no trapped air and then a bag, or an ice glaze made by dipping the frozen fillet in cold water and letting the film set. The tail end of the fillet is thin and burns first. Freeze it in the portions you will cook, lay them flat, label them. The fish stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; what runs out is quality.
en.thawing: Overnight in the fridge on a plate, or sealed in a bag under cold running water. Not on the counter, and never in warm water — the thin end starts cooking before the thick end has thawed. Dry it well before it meets the pan, cook it promptly, and do not refreeze it raw.
spoilage: A sour or ammoniacal smell instead of a clean, mild one.
Flesh that stays dented when pressed rather than springing back.
Skin that has gone dull brown-orange and slimy rather than bright and firm.
Milky liquid pooling under the fillet, or gaping flakes.
tips: Leave the skin on for storage; it protects the flesh.
Ask whether the fillet was previously frozen — if so, do not refreeze it raw.
Ice-glaze thin tail ends before freezing; they burn first.
Store in a single layer, not stacked.

faq.q: How long does ocean perch keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on ice and in a single layer.
Yes, 4–8 months at −18 °C, wrapped airtight or ice-glazed. Do not refreeze a fillet that was sold thawed from frozen.

faq.q: Can you eat the orange skin?
faq.a: Yes. It is edible, crisps nicely, and protects the flesh while the fillet is stored.

faq.q: How can you tell if ocean perch has gone off?
faq.a: A sour or ammoniacal smell, dull slimy skin, milky liquid under the fillet, or flesh that will not spring back.

zh.name: 紅魚
zh.summary: 紅魚是深海的岩礁魚種，市面上幾乎都是帶皮魚片，那層鮮橘紅的魚皮正是攤位上辨識魚種的依據。魚肉結實、味道清甜，含油量比扁身魚略高一些，這也讓它的冷凍期限落在 4～8 個月而不是更長。從購買日起冷藏可放 1～2 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有。在紅魚進到你家廚房之前，已經有兩件事對它不利。它在離岸很遠的深海捕獲，所以櫃上賣的很多是在船上就冷凍、到店裡才解凍陳列的，也就是說它的時鐘在你看到之前早就開始走了——請開口問，因為如果答案是解凍品，生的就絕對不能再冷凍。用保冷袋帶回家，遵守 2 小時上限，氣溫超過 32 °C 時縮到 1 小時。
zh.fridge: 從購買日起放 4 °C 以下 1～2 天。魚最適合的溫度比冰箱還低一點、接近冰點，所以請把魚片放在網架上、底下鋪冰、整組裝進有蓋的盒子，並讓融水流到魚碰不到的地方。放置期間魚皮留著：它能吃、煎起來很脆，而且在下鍋之前，它就是魚肉和空氣之間的一道屏障。刺請在保存前就挑掉，不要等之後再處理，這樣魚只被翻動一次。新鮮的紅魚聞起來是乾淨的海水味；一旦出現阿摩尼亞味就結束了，而深海魚走到那一步很快。
zh.freezer: 在 −18 °C 下 4～8 個月。給紅魚風味的那點油脂，同時也是限制它期限的東西，所以包裝要照長期的標準做：保鮮膜緊貼魚肉、不留任何空氣，外面再加一層袋子；或者把凍硬的魚片浸一下冷水，讓表面結成一層冰衣。魚片尾端薄，一定是那裡先凍燒。按會下鍋的份量分裝、壓平、貼標籤。在 −18 °C 下安全性可以無限期維持，會用完的是品質。
zh.thawing: 放盤子上冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋以冷水沖。不要放檯面，更不要泡溫水——薄的那一端會先熟，厚的那端還沒化開。下鍋前徹底擦乾、盡快烹調，生魚不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有氨味，而不是乾淨溫和的魚味。
按壓後凹陷回不來，而不是有彈性。
魚皮由鮮亮轉成暗褐橘並發黏。
魚片下方積出乳白液體，或肌肉纖維裂開。
tips: 保存時把魚皮留著，它會保護魚肉。
問清楚是不是解凍品；是的話生魚不要再冷凍。
薄的尾端冷凍前先做冰鍍，那裡最先凍燒。

faq.a: 鋪冰單層平放、4 °C 以下，從購買日起 1～2 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 4～8 個月，密封包好或做冰鍍。解凍品不要生的再冷凍。
可以。它能吃、煎起來很脆，保存期間也保護魚肉。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷紅魚不新鮮了？
faq.a: 發酸或氨味、魚皮暗淡發黏、魚片下積乳白液體，或按壓沒有彈性。
